name: ABC Legal
desc:
Become a Legal Process Server | Pay Per Job (varies) | Driving and In-Person Heavy, No Office |


Company: ABC Legal Services
Position Title: Legal Process Server (1099 Independent Contractor)
 Industry: Legal Services / Document Delivery
 Realistic Job Overview and Responsibilities:
ABC Legal is a national process serving company that delivers legal documents on behalf of banks and law firms. As a process server, you pick up jobs through the ABC Legal app, drive to the recipient's address, deliver the documents, and log the attempt. You are paid per job, not per hour.
Key responsibilities from the posting:
Claim jobs through ABC Legal's mobile app and plan your delivery route
Attempt delivery to recipients at variable times including mornings, evenings, and weekends
Document each attempt accurately through the app
Make follow-up attempts every 48 hours as required
Interact professionally with recipients at the door
Scan and print documents as needed
This is a driving role. You are in your own vehicle, setting your own schedule, working your own territory. The more jobs you claim and complete, the more you earn. There is no guaranteed income floor. You are paid per attempt and success. Earnings are uncapped. 
 
Career Pathway: Process Server → Senior Process Server → Team Lead (internal ABC Legal) → Process Server Trainer → Operations Coordinator
assessment:
Requires a state license it is important to know that all private process server licenses in Oklahoma are applied for locally but grant immediate statewide authority
No exam required.
skills:
Statutory Prerequisites
To qualify under Oklahoma Statutes Title 12 § 158.1, participants must meet the following baseline criteria: [1, 2]
Age: At least 18 years old. [1]
Residency: Must be an Oklahoma resident for at least 6 months, and a resident of their specific county for at least 30 days prior to filing. [1]
Background Check: Must be of good moral character, ethically/mentally fit, and have no felony convictions or pending criminal charges. [1, 2]
No Education/Testing Required: Unlike other legal fields, Oklahoma does not require a formal exam, certification course, or previous experience to get a license. [1, 2]
notes: If interested in becoming a licensed process server for ABC Legal, complete their application and talk to your coach about funding options
other:
The Oklahoma Sooner Private Process Server Association, which is the state's professional association for licensed servers, has 21 members listed statewide across all 77 counties. That is not oversaturated. That is actually thin coverage, especially in rural areas

Is it dangerous? Occasionally, yes. Most serves are uneventful but some recipients are hostile, and servers do encounter situations that escalate. This is real and worth naming honestly in any participant-facing material.
Is it emotionally difficult? It can be. Serving eviction notices, divorce papers, and child custody documents means you are sometimes the person delivering news that changes someone's life. That lands differently on different people.
training: discussed in interview/ofer stage. must be available for any shift
